sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 20

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section I, List of Answers on Terminology 20:1
items.html: When speaking of the relations of cause and consequence among the emanated beings, the cause is expressed by the word “before,” and the consequence of that cause is expressed by the word “afterwards.” See Item 16. (Part 1, Inner Observation, Item 34)
